l-e-h2-b04-12.goal: Buka no hatete regra ba verbu ajuda iha kláuzula rezultadu husi hanoin ipotétiku kona-ba pasadu iha kazu oioin, no koko regra ne'e ho kazu foun ida.
l-e-h2-b04-12.material: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus. (sei hetan duni) / ..., I could have caught it. (bele hetan) / ..., I might have caught it. (karik hetan) Buka regra.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.a: Verbu ajuda tolu ne'e iha signifikadu hanesan
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.a: Signifikadu sira iha paréntese diferente malu.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.b: would mak konfiansa, could mak posibilidade, might mak la konfiansa
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.o.c: would la konfiansa no might mak rezultadu ne'ebé konfiável
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.c: would konfiável no might la konfiansa.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.r.d: could mak posibilidade, no rezultadu konfiável mak would.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s1.explain: Iha hanoin ipotétiku kona-ba pasadu, would have hatudu rezultadu konfiável, could have hatudu buat ne'ebé posível, no might have hatudu rezultadu ne'ebé la konfiável.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s2.model.0: would signifika sei hetan duni, could signifika bele hetan, no might signifika karik hetan, tanba ne'e verbu ajuda hatete nivel konfiansa ba rezultadu.
l-e-h2-b04-12.s.s2.model.1: Maski kláuzula if hanesan, signifikadu iha paréntese diferente, tanba ne'e verbu ajuda iha kláuzula rezultadu troka nivel konfiansa.

l-e-h2-b03-21.material: ①Originál: If I had known, I would have called. ②Hasai if no lori had ba oin sujeitu: Had I ... ③Troka known ba forma bázika know: Had I know. ④Konkluzaun: Had I know, I would have called.

l-e-h2-b03-21.s.s2.model.0: Troka known ba forma bázika iha ③ mak sala, nune'e had de'it mak tenke muda ba oin no husik known hanesan.

l-e-h2-b03-33.material: Nia signifika 'If I had a pen, I would lend it to you.' A: If I had a pen, I would lend it to you. B: If I would have a pen, I would lend it to you.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s1.o.a: A: Uza forma pasadu iha kláuzula if.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s1.o.b: B: Uza would iha kláuzula if mós.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s1.r.b: Labele uza would iha kláuzula if.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s1.r.c: B la natural tanba iha would ida iha kláuzula if.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s1.r.d: A mak fraze ne'ebé tuir regra.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s1.explain: Ba situasaun imajinária ne'ebé kontráriu ba faktu, uza forma pasadu (had) iha kláuzula if no would iha kláuzula prinsipál. Labele uza would iha kláuzula if.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s2.model.0: Kláuzula if uza forma pasadu had, no uza would iha kláuzula prinsipál de'it, nune'e A mak apropriadu liu.
l-e-h2-b03-33.s.s2.model.1: B kontra regra tanba iha would iha kláuzula if, nune'e A mak fraze loos.

l-e-h2-b03-34.title: Dalan rua atu adivinha signifikadu scarce
l-e-h2-b03-34.goal: Kompara dalan ka alegasaun rua atu adivinha signifikadu scarce, hili ida ne'ebé apropriadu liu, no esplika razaun.
l-e-h2-b03-34.material: Mai adivinha signifikadu scarce iha 'Water is scarce in the desert, so people save every drop.' A: Adivinha husi kontestu tuirmai, 'save every drop'. B: Nia hanesan scare (atu halo tauk), nune'e lee nia hanesan 'scary'.
l-e-h2-b03-34.s.s1.o.a: A: Uza kontestu besik nu'udar indísiu.
l-e-h2-b03-34.s.s1.r.c: B depende de'it ba forma hakerek nian, la'ós ba kontestu.
l-e-h2-b03-34.s.s1.r.d: A mak métodu ne'ebé bele fiar.
l-e-h2-b03-34.s.s1.explain: Kontestu kona-ba rai bee-tun hotu-hotu hatudu katak bee uitoan. Scarce signifika 'raro, iha kuantidade menus'.
l-e-h2-b03-34.s.s2.model.0: Kontestu rai bee-tun hotu-hotu mak indísiu katak bee uitoan, nune'e A mak apropriadu liu.
l-e-h2-b03-34.s.s2.model.1: Hakerek hanesan scare la halo signifikadu hanesan, nune'e A ne'ebé haree kontestu mak bele fiar liu.

l-e-h2-b03-35.goal: Kompara dalan ka alegasaun rua kona-ba elementu fraze husi Whatever you choose, hili ida ne'ebé apropriadu liu, no esplika razaun.
l-e-h2-b03-35.material: Mai esplika 'Whatever you choose is fine.' A: Whatever you choose mak kláuzula substantivu ne'ebé funsiona nu'udar sujeitu. B: Whatever you choose mak fraze independente.
l-e-h2-b03-35.s.s1.o.a: A: Nia funsiona nu'udar sujeitu iha fraze.
l-e-h2-b03-35.s.s1.o.b: B: Nia fraze ketak ne'ebé independente.

l-e-h2-b03-35.s.s1.r.d: A mak esplikasaun ne'ebé tuir estrutura fraze.

l-e-h2-b03-35.s.s2.model.1: Karik fraze independente hanesan B, is fine sei la iha sujeitu, nune'e fraze la funsiona.

l-e-h2-b04-31.goal: Kompara métodu ka afirmasaun rua kona-ba fraze invertida ne'ebé hahú ho present participle, hili ida ne'ebé apropriadu liu, no esplika razaun.

l-e-h2-b04-31.s.s1.r.b: Iha fraze invertida ida-ne'e, was tenke mai molok sujeitu.

l-e-h2-b04-31.s.s2.model.1: Iha B, sujeitu iha molok was, ne'ebé diferente hosi orden liafuan fraze invertida nian, nune'e la naturál.

l-e-h2-b04-33.topic: Liafuan sira ne'ebé fasil atu kahur
l-e-h2-b04-33.goal: Kompara métodu ka afirmasaun rua kona-ba liafuan ba labarik ne'ebé sensível ba lian, hili ida ne'ebé apropriadu liu, no esplika razaun.
l-e-h2-b04-33.material: Ita hakarak deskreve labarik ne'ebé reaje lalais ba lian. A: The baby is sensible to noise. B: The baby is sensitive to noise.
l-e-h2-b04-33.s.s1.r.a: Sensible signifika 'iha hanoin di'ak'. La signifika sensitive.
l-e-h2-b04-33.s.s1.r.c: Liafuan rua ne'e iha signifikadu diferente.
l-e-h2-b04-33.s.s1.explain: Sensitive signifika 'fasil atu afeta, delikadu', no sensible signifika 'iha hanoin di'ak'. Labarik ne'ebé sensível ba lian mak sensitive.
l-e-h2-b04-33.s.s2.model.0: Reaje lalais ba lian signifika sensível, nune'e sensitive mak loos.
l-e-h2-b04-33.s.s2.model.1: Sensible signifika iha hanoin di'ak, nune'e la adekuadu ba labarik ne'ebé reaje ba lian.

l-e-h2-b05-31.s.s1.r.a: Fraze inversaun nian di'ak ba enfatiza iha diskursu ka hakerek. Sira todan iha mensajen ba belun.

l-e-h2-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: Mensajen ba belun di'ak ho laran casual, nune'e B, ho ordenu liafuan komún, mak naturál liu.

l-e-h2-b05-32.title: Espresaun ida-ne'ebé fó razaun atu lori guarda-xuva mak saida?
l-e-h2-b05-32.goal: Kompara dalan ka alegasaun rua atu dehan atu prepara ba udan, hili ida ne'ebé tuir di'ak liu, no esplika razaun.
l-e-h2-b05-32.material: Ita hakarak dehan katak ema ida tenke prepara molok udan tun. A: Take an umbrella if it rains. B: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.prompt: Ida-ne'ebé tuir di'ak liu signifikadu prepara uluk nian?
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.a: A: "if" signifika lori guarda-xuva bainhira udan tun
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.r.a: "if" mak kondisaun ne'ebé signifika halo ida-ne'e bainhira udan tun. Nia la'ós prepara uluk.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.b: B: "in case" signifika lori nia uluk tanba karik udan sei tun
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.r.c: "if" mak kondisaun ba depois udan tun.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.o.d: La iha ida mak iha relasaun ho prepara
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s1.explain: "in case ~" mak prepara tanba 'karik ~'. "if ~" mak kondisaun ne'ebé halo ita atua bainhira buat ida akontese.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s2.model.0: "in case it rains" signifika lori nia uluk tanba karik udan sei tun, nune'e B mak tuir.
l-e-h2-b05-32.s.s2.model.1: "if it rains" mak kondisaun ba depois udan tun, nune'e la tuir signifikadu prepara uluk nian.

l-e-h2-b06-33.title: implied ka inferred?
l-e-h2-b06-33.goal: Kompara dalan rua atu hato'o buat ne'ebé artigu ida hatudu maibé la dehan direta, hili liafuan ida ne'ebé di'ak liu, no esplika razaun.

l-e-h2-b06-34.s.s2.model.1: Naran ida labele mai kedas depois de How, nune'e B sala.
